hypothesis: A strictly predecision, complete-basket modeled primary-market exposure may add residual five-session price information beyond a fixed PIT baseline; effect sign unspecified.
evidence: PF052 pre-outcome candidate specification exists locally; this audit refines identifiability and falsification, not market outcome evidence.

audit.risk: reported unit change may include operational adjustments, not pure net creations
audit.support: issuer outstanding-unit observations and date-effective PCF can be observed
audit.counter: T-2 review reversals, dual-currency conversions, unit actions, gross creations and redemptions not separately identified
audit.failure: component of unit change not source-verified
audit.action: label modeled basket as conditional proxy; prohibit actual-creation and actual-stock-trade claims

audit.risk: incomplete basket changes exposure and study population
audit.support: issuer PCF describes possible in-kind delivery
audit.counter: web preview rows do not prove full component coverage; cash substitutes differ by security
audit.alternative: partial display, cash-only mechanics, data extraction truncation
audit.failure: row count, completeness and cash-substitution flags unverified
audit.action: mark whole fund-date unusable for full-basket factor; preserve UNKNOWN rather than zero

audit.support: lagged volume can scale basket exposure
audit.counter: current-session volume, split changes, zero-volume halts and incomplete sessions contaminate denominator
audit.failure: 20 prior completed session receipts missing or zero
audit.action: compute only on completed pre-cutoff sessions, date-effective security identities and corporate-action basis; otherwise UNKNOWN

audit.risk: forward-return execution window may be non-tradable
audit.support: first executable open is a reproducible hypothetical entry clock
audit.counter: halts, price limits, suspensions, delistings, zero volume or missing open cannot be filled as a normal trade
audit.alternative: close-to-close descriptive return is not executable return
audit.action: separate descriptive outcome from executable outcome, preserve censored/UNKNOWN and test selection effects

audit.risk: same date multiple funds and overlapping five-session outcomes inflate independent N
audit.counter: common index and same calendar return windows produce correlated errors
audit.alternative: market or index event drives both
audit.failure: date cluster, chronological holdout and overlap purge not implemented
audit.action: independent unit is decision-date cluster; purge every overlapping label interval, apply embargo only after exact calendar alignment

audit.risk: fund-label shuffle is not an exchangeable negative control
audit.counter: fund identity predicts sector, holdings, size and basket composition
audit.action: use conditional placebo within date, sector, size/liquidity and eligible basket support only after independent review

audit.risk: complete-case PCF selection can bias cross-fund inference
audit.support: fully sourced fund dates allow reproducible analysis
audit.counter: missing PCF is related to issuer, fund type, trading activity or reporting process
audit.failure: coverage table and attrition strata missing
audit.action: pre-register missingness and support by fund/date/type; do not claim whole-market generalization

audit.risk: duplicate event roots masquerade as independent factors
audit.support: ETF flows, index events, institutional flow, borrowing and crowding may be linked
audit.counter: single event can create multiple receipts and borrow/hedge legs
audit.action: one event root, many consumers; residual comparison after D11-14 and D06-11 shared-parent controls

audit.risk: source first-known time and dynamic issuer page conflict
audit.counter: web page date alone cannot prove predecision availability; historical PF048-PF050 issuer-version conflicts unresolved
audit.alternative: cache, selector, dynamic response, true revision
audit.failure: immutable raw, request parameters, source version and independent firstKnownAt absent
audit.action: block historical predecision eligibility; append vintages, never backfill

audit.risk: transaction costs and true borrow utilization misidentified
audit.support: 30/60/100 bp stress is a bounded hypothetical sensitivity
audit.counter: actual AP stock executions and full lendable inventory not observed
audit.alternative: existing inventory, borrow, cash substitution and hedging
audit.failure: actual fills/depth and lendable denominator unavailable
audit.action: report hypothetical-cost sensitivity only; actual execution and true utilization UNKNOWN

validation.primaryFeature: signed conditional modeled PCF basket exposure over lagged 20-session ADV
validation.primaryOutcome: first verified executable open to fifth completed session close
validation.comparison: identical-support baseline versus baseline plus single feature
validation.controls: chronological holdout, label-overlap purge, conditional negative control, attrition table, date clustering, multiple-testing ledger

next: Read latest main and this checkpoint, obtain immutable complete PCF and source clock; submit PF052/PF053 prereg to D16/00; gather genuinely new independent dates; do not open outcomes until prereg accepted and PIT support frozen.
